E0762

`#Context` field type mismatch (`allocator` must be an allocator handle; `deadline` must be Int epoch-ms)

What

`#Context` field type mismatch (`allocator` must be an allocator handle; `deadline` must be Int epoch-ms)

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0762

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0762: tests/ui/context_wrong_type.stderr.

Error [E0762]: `allocator` needs an allocator, got Int (a whole number)
  --> tests/ui/context_wrong_type.jet:3:14
    |
  3 |     #Context(allocator: 42) {
    |              ^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: the `allocator` field takes an `Arena`, `Bump`, `Pool`, or `Fixed` value
 Fix: pass an allocator, e.g. `mem.Arena.new()`
